import json,pathlib
out=pathlib.Path(__file__).parent
ps=json.loads((out/'candidates.json').read_text());rs=json.loads((out.parent/'inventory/requirements.json').read_text())
notes={
'C0001':('intentional_dependency','Manifest root entry delegates to existing access/member routing. Preserved body names former household-identity owner; app-installation lines 10-15 explicitly relocate the member requirements to member-context. This is intentional preserved wording plus navigation dependency, not a stale-owner defect. A selected-block loader must retain relocation/dependency preambles or read the relevant full scope.'),
'C0007':('unresolved_ownership','Same GET status endpoint/result projection overlaps for ordinary workflows; demo requirement additionally owns selection across ordinary and demo types. Outcomes agree, but projection authority is not named. Request owner clarification before any consolidation; no contradiction proven.'),
'C0008':('intentional_dependency','Restore with compatible sidecar rebuilds from restored facts; ordinary indexing publishes before optional embedding. Different triggers and guarantees; search-indexing explicitly links restore ownership.'),
'C0011':('intentional_dependency','Different cookies and writer actions. Member cookie explicitly consumes access-cookie domain/Secure policy; common flags are intentional dependency.'),
'C0014':('intentional_overlap','Invite acceptance selects an existing invited identity; onboarding first creates a member. Common selection/Home handoff does not erase distinct triggers or failure boundaries.'),
'C0017':('intentional_overlap','Invite acceptance versus Profile member-menu selection; different triggers and cookie prerequisites, shared downstream selection.'),
'C0021':('intentional_exception','Stream requires cookie specifically; general binding permits header precedence only for shared-binding actions and explicitly preserves endpoint-specific checks. Not a contradiction.'),
'C0027':('intentional_overlap','Recipe assign POST takes relative week/index/recipe; non-cooking validate/remove use explicit date and no recipe. Shared authentication policy does not make operations duplicates.'),
'C0029':('intentional_difference','Recipe assignment recomputes groceries and emits week + invalidation; recipe-free save emits slot only and explicitly forbids those follow-ups. Different triggers/representations.'),
'C0030':('intentional_overlap','Planner/Search/Browse and Home callers separately require committed Tomorrow result; Home adds validation and incomplete-follow-up scenarios. Shared invariant, distinct caller coverage.'),
'C0031':('intentional_difference','Quick Find live pool prioritizes cooked-date before likes; Discovery queue prioritizes likes before date. Separate query surfaces and scenarios explicitly establish different orderings.'),
'C0032':('intentional_overlap','Same GET suggestion contract/read-only guarantee is repeated, but meal-planning explicitly retains Discovery threshold/ranking authority. Preserve caller safety and policy ownership; potential documentation compression requires traceability design.'),
'C0037':('intentional_overlap','Highest lexical score: Remove recipe versus Remove supper plan pivots. Same optimistic delete mechanics, distinct recipe-backed/recipe-free triggers and user-cleared detail; date-delete owner remains meal-rescheduling.'),
'C0038':('intentional_dependency','Member preferences owns persistence/reset on presentation switch; library owns default stack and paged data fetch. Different effects on same control.'),
'C0039':('intentional_difference','Recipe-free save and existing recipe-backed validation both publish slots; predicates and response semantics differ, including cooked flag. No conflicting follow-up rule.'),
'C0041':('true_textual_duplication','Normative bodies are byte-identical, same ready-step trigger and database facts/publication outcome. Both scenarios also have identical WHEN/THEN/AND bodies; only requirement and first scenario titles differ. Source-mode headings suggest intentional historical coverage, but duplicate normative text is proven; consolidation needs explicit approval and source/title/scenario traceability, not automatic deletion.'),
'C0043':('intentional_overlap','Discovery card and Home invitation both navigate to absolute round week without mutation; Home additionally guards missing/stale round identity. Distinct activation surfaces and recovery obligations.'),
'C0051':('intentional_dependency','Recipe-quality owns report membership/precedence; Search explicitly consumes it while retaining text/hard filters/Focus retrieval. Consistent repeated scenario demonstrates composition, not a second independent policy.')}
notes.update({k:tuple(v) for k,v in json.loads((out/'remaining_review.json').read_text()).items()})
reviewed=[]
for p in ps:
 if p['id'] in notes:p['classification'],p['rationale']=notes[p['id']];p['review']='full_requirement_and_scenarios';reviewed.append(p)
(out/'candidates.json').write_text(json.dumps(ps,indent=2,ensure_ascii=False)+'\n')
manual=[('M001',('planning-lifecycle',56),('planning-lifecycle',237),'Browser promotion is multiple requests and non-atomic; durable close of persisted plan/history/votes is atomic. The pending-browser-suggestion scenario explicitly preserves that separate boundary. No contradiction.'),('M002',('meal-planning',173),('household-live-updates',280),'Initialization fetch/composition versus received live-default reconciliation. Both preserve occupied slots, while live update additionally clears withdrawn suggestions. Distinct triggers; Discovery retains consensus.'),('M003',('recipe-library',509),('recipe-quality',451),'DTO canReimport represents source availability; contextual processing requires eligible feedback, provenance and repeated-feedback policy. Representation is not launch/completion guarantee.'),('M004',('capture-recovery',237),('recipe-quality',143),'Durable accepted intake recovery versus saved-content issue report eligibility. A recoverable failed capture is not a contextual feedback attempt; both preserve acceptance/completion distinction.')]
for id,a,b,reason in manual:
 reviewed.append({'id':id,'triggers':['targeted_boundary_review'],'left':next(r for r in rs if (r['capability'],r['start_line'])==a),'right':next(r for r in rs if (r['capability'],r['start_line'])==b),'classification':'intentional_dependency','rationale':reason,'review':'full_requirement_and_scenarios'})
(out/'reviewed.json').write_text(json.dumps(reviewed,indent=2,ensure_ascii=False)+'\n')
lines=['# Stage 2 ownership and overlap findings','', 'Revision: a3232949b1fd627771ebe9ee68a975170f1798ad. Canonical specs were read only.','', '## Method and limits','', 'Consume Stage 1 requirements.json; candidates.py documents exact normalization, fixed stopwords, score and stable ordering. All 808 requirements are compared for exact title and whitespace/NFC-normalized pre-scenario body. Lexical scoring covers cross-capability pairs only, title + normative body, ASCII identifier tokens, Jaccard >= 0.25 and at least five shared terms. No embedding or automatic semantic decision. Exact raw bodies, full blocks, hashes and inclusive 1-based spans accompany every candidate in candidates.json.','', 'Results: 0 exact-title duplicate pairs; 1 normalized-body duplicate pair; 50 cross-capability lexical pairs; 51 distinct flagged pairs. Reviewed all 51 generated pairs fully including scenarios, plus 4 targeted boundary pairs. Zero generated candidates remain unreviewed. This exhausts the declared exact-match/lexical candidate set, not all semantic relationships; no exhaustive absence-of-contradictions claim. 1 proven duplicated normative text/shared finalization obligation restated for two intake paths (not established as an architectural defect), 1 unresolved ownership overlap; remaining reviewed pairs intentional. Candidate counts are not duplicate counts.','', '## Findings','']
for p in reviewed:
 lines += [f"### {p['id']} — {p['classification']}",'']
 for side in ['left','right']:
  r=p[side];lines += [f"- `{r['path']}:{r['start_line']}-{r['end_line']}` — {r['title']}; block SHA-256 `{r['sha256']}`, body SHA-256 `{r['body_sha256']}`"]
 lines += ['',p['rationale'],'']
lines+=['## Ownership across priority boundaries','', '| Boundary | Current normative owners and consequences |','|---|---|','| Planning / assignment / lifecycle | meal-planning reads and presentation; meal-assignment chosen-recipe writes/recovery; meal-rescheduling move/defer/shared deletion; non-cooking-plans recipe-free UI/save; planning-lifecycle voting/lock/day validation/finalization; deployment-calendar date authority. Browser promotion and durable close are separate boundaries. |','| Discovery / live updates | recipe-discovery owns queue eligibility/votes/consensus/suggestion placement; household-live-updates owns connection, publication attempts, received reconciliation; meal-planning owns initialization composition. Receipt is not durable delivery, and suggestion is not assignment. |','| Search / indexing / library | recipe-search owns retrieval/ranking/promotion; search-indexing materializes facts/documents and embeddings; recipe-library owns catalog eligibility/detail representation; recipe-quality supplies review membership; recycle-bin supplies deletion policy. Restore and ordinary indexing use different triggers. |','| Capture / quality / recovery | recipe-capture owns intake/readiness; recipe-quality saved issue/contextual attempts; capture-recovery failed intake/workflow retry/clear; background-processing execution and reset; scheduled-maintenance cleanup; recipe-library provenance/readiness representation. Re-import availability is not automatic eligibility or success. |','', 'Purpose/related-owner introductions were read for the eleven named priority capabilities; their explicit links support these boundaries. Existing split history was a navigation hint only; current files establish conclusions.','', '## Link check','', 'links.py scans inline relative Markdown links in canonical specs only. 171 links checked; all target files and GitHub-style heading slugs resolved locally. The slug checker appends collision suffixes for duplicate headings within each file, but approximates GitHub Markdown behavior; unusual inline markup, Unicode slug edge cases, reference-style links, code fences and renderer differences are outside this bounded check. This is a syntactic check, not proof of semantic ownership correctness, remote immutable links, runtime guarantees or all possible Markdown syntax. Exact records in links.json.','', '## Recommendations requiring separate approval','', '1. Keep v1 audit reporting-only: stable source spans, exact raw evidence/hashes, explicit candidate versus reviewed decisions. Never delete/move requirements automatically.','2. Decide whether the duplicated ready-step requirement should remain explicit per-source coverage or later gain one shared owner plus preserved URL/photo scenarios and provenance mapping. No canonical change is part of this audit.','3. Clarify the owner of GET management/status projection between demo-household and data-backup-and-recovery before considering consolidation. They agree on observed result selection; ownership remains unclear.','4. Treat lexical scoring as a recall-limited review aid. Same-endpoint, policy links and targeted boundary selection caught useful pairs below lexical threshold; no measured semantic recall percentage is justified.','5. All 51 generated candidates have full requirement/scenario review; broader semantic recall remains unmeasured. Validate exact block/scenario conservation, owner links and scenario mappings for any later proposed reorganization.','', '## Reproduction','', 'Run `python3 candidates.py ../inventory/requirements.json OUTPUT_DIRECTORY` from this directory, then `python3 review.py` to apply this fixed human-reviewed decision record. Run `python3 links.py` from the repository root (its output destination is this audit temp folder). Python stdlib only; no installs. Scripts write only explicit temporary output artifacts. review.py plus remaining_review.json are a reproducible record of human decisions, not an automated semantic oracle.','', 'Memory consulted: MEMORY.md:54-101 (previous capability split navigation); thread 01a14795-5873-73a3-8c9f-01c42cede754. All factual findings verified against current canonical files.']
(out/'findings.md').write_text('\n'.join(lines)+'\n')
summary=json.loads((out/'summary.json').read_text())
from collections import Counter
summary.update(generated_reviewed=len(notes),generated_unreviewed=len(ps)-len(notes),targeted_reviewed=len(manual),reviewed_total=len(reviewed),reviewed_classifications=dict(Counter(p['classification'] for p in reviewed)))
(out/'summary.json').write_text(json.dumps(summary,indent=2)+'\n')
print(len(reviewed),'reviewed;',len(ps)-len(notes),'generated unreviewed')

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Audit evidence generator only. Writes solely to explicit --output temporary directory."""
import argparse, hashlib, json, pathlib, subprocess, time
p=argparse.ArgumentParser();p.add_argument('--repo',required=True);p.add_argument('--inventory',required=True);p.add_argument('--output',required=True);a=p.parse_args()
repo=pathlib.Path(a.repo).resolve();out=pathlib.Path(a.output).resolve();out.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
assert repo not in out.parents and repo != out, 'evidence generator must run outside repo'
start=time.perf_counter()
inv=json.loads((pathlib.Path(a.inventory)/'inventory.json').read_text());rs=json.loads((pathlib.Path(a.inventory)/'requirements.json').read_text())
fs=inv['files'];by={(r['capability'],r['title']):r for r in rs};sources={f['path']:(repo/f['path']).read_bytes() for f in fs}
assert all(hashlib.sha256(sources[f['path']]).hexdigest()==f['sha256'] for f in fs)
for r in rs:
 raw=b''.join(sources[r['path']].splitlines(keepends=True)[r['start_line']-1:r['end_line']]);assert raw.decode()==r['raw_block'];assert hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()==r['sha256']
index=[]
for f in fs:
 index.append({'capability':f['capability'],'path':f['path'],'sha256':f['sha256'],'purpose':f['purpose'],'requirements':[{'title':r['title'],'start_line':r['start_line'],'end_line':r['end_line'],'sha256':r['sha256'],'scenarios':len(r['scenarios'])} for r in rs if r['capability']==f['capability']]})
def dump(name,obj):
 raw=(json.dumps(obj,ensure_ascii=False,sort_keys=True,indent=2)+'\n').encode();(out/name).write_bytes(raw);return raw
def measure(raw,reads):return {'utf8_bytes':len(raw),'characters':len(raw.decode()),'source_reads':reads,'sha256':hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(),'tokens':None}
global_index=dump('capability-index.json',index)
W=[{'id':'small-ui','request':'Keep recipe detail Share disabled throughout preparation and delivery; preserve eligibility, cancellation, fallback and error behavior. No API or import changes.','reference':{'recipe-sharing':['Offer Share action on eligible ready recipes in loaded detail','Generate privacy-scrubbed portable export bundle','Deliver export bundle via native sharing with download fallback','Disable Share while a share operation is pending']},'initial':{'recipe-sharing':['Disable Share while a share operation is pending']}},
{'id':'planner-cross-capability','request':'Correct dated same-week Planner drag and keyboard movement while retaining source-date identity, optimistic restoration, captured reference weeks, and live snapshot/echo reconciliation. No Tomorrow, defer, assignment or recipe-free clear changes.','reference':{
'meal-rescheduling':['Preview a drag as a swap of dated Planner content','Submit dated-source movement through the protected operation','Prefer an explicit movement source with legacy fallback','Swap stored content within a week','Distinguish movement follow-ups from movement confirmation','Activate Planner dragging after a deliberate hold','Cancel pending Planner holds before drag activation','Bound Planner grabbed feedback to the active pointer interaction','Offer keyboard movement through the Planner handle'],
'deployment-calendar':['Resolve supper dates through the deployment calendar','Expose one authoritative calendar context with schedule reads','Keep relative operations anchored to their intended calendar week','Preserve civil-date arithmetic through daylight saving changes'],
'meal-planning':['Read the household schedule through the protected GET operation','Return seven dates from the deployment calendar week','Project stored recipe and non-cooking read content','Read week status and stored adjuncts without creating a plan','Use enveloped schedule data for browser initialization','Compose voting suggestions separately from persisted assignments','Discard initialization results for a different selected offset','Render day content and planned count from displayed state'],
'household-live-updates':['Reconcile only the displayed snapshot week','Defer day replacement during local moves','Preserve existing day content under snapshot merge guards','Apply available snapshot adjuncts conditionally','Use connection identity only for immediate echo exclusion','Bound delivery to current process registrations','Attempt incremental schedule publication after supported saves','Dispatch week updates through existing snapshot guards','Consume move echoes as confirmation before offset filtering','Identify received relative-week data by absolute deployment week','Reuse household transport for session updates'],
'household-identity':['Authenticate protected API requests independently']},'initial':{'meal-rescheduling':['Preview a drag as a swap of dated Planner content','Offer keyboard movement through the Planner handle']}},
{'id':'background-lifecycle','request':'Review a proposed stale-processing reclamation cutoff/loop interval change while preserving dispatch, retry distinction, retained task/parent context, failure handling and injected UTC clock. No trigger/reset/pruning/maintenance composition changes.','reference':{
'background-processing':['Select due pending tasks for processor dispatch','Record processor execution and successful task completion','Classify automatic retry eligibility at the attempt boundary','Persist retries on the existing task','Attempt stale-task reclamation from the hosted loop','Requeue processing tasks strictly older than the stale cutoff','Retain reclamation context without applying retry or parent gates','Contain reclamation failures at the loop boundary','Poll pending work with capped idle backoff','Use local processor slots for dispatch'],
'application-time':['Use supplied application time']},'initial':{'background-processing':['Requeue processing tasks strictly older than the stale cutoff']}}]
results=[]
for w in W:
 d=out/w['id'];d.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
 refs=[by[(c,t)] for c,ts in w['reference'].items() for t in ts];initial=[by[(c,t)] for c,ts in w['initial'].items() for t in ts]
 caps=sorted(w['reference']);files=[f for f in fs if f['capability'] in caps]
 scoped=dump(w['id']+'/index.json',[f for f in index if f['capability'] in caps])
 # Full-file phase concatenation introduces no byte separators. Reads are per source file.
 full=b''.join(sources[f['path']] for f in files);(d/'full-scope.md').write_bytes(full)
 # Keep ALL pre-requirement material, including qualification and dependency links.
 preambles=[]
 for f in files:
  first=min(r['start_line'] for r in rs if r['capability']==f['capability'])
  preambles.append(b''.join(sources[f['path']].splitlines(keepends=True)[:first-1]))
 selected=b''.join(preambles)+''.join(r['raw_block'] for r in refs).encode();(d/'selected.md').write_bytes(selected)
 sparse=''.join(r['raw_block'] for r in initial).encode();(d/'sparse-initial.md').write_bytes(sparse)
 misses=[{'path':r['path'],'title':r['title'],'start_line':r['start_line'],'end_line':r['end_line'],'scenario_titles':[s['title'] for s in r['scenarios']]} for r in refs if r not in initial]
 manifest={'workload':w,'full_scope_files':files,'reference_requirements':refs,'initial_selection_misses':misses,'final_selection_misses':[],'criteria':'Manual whole-file review of declared capability scope; includes immediate cross-owner obligations, every scenario in selected whole requirement blocks, and full source preambles. Not proof of universal semantic completeness.'}
 dump(w['id']+'/manifest.json',manifest)
 n=len(files);f=measure(full,n);s=measure(selected,1);i=measure(scoped,1);g=measure(global_index,1)
 results.append({'id':w['id'],'capabilities':caps,'reference_requirement_count':len(refs),'reference_scenario_count':sum(len(r['scenarios']) for r in refs),'initial_requirements':len(initial),'initial_scenarios':sum(len(r['scenarios']) for r in initial),'initial_recall':len(initial)/len(refs),'final_recall':1.0,'full_phase':f,'selected_phase':s,'scoped_index':i,'global_index':g,
 'exploration_only_scoped':measure(scoped+selected,2),'exploration_only_global':measure(global_index+selected,2),
 'compliant_baseline_two_full_phases':measure(full+full,2*n),
 'compliant_selective_scoped_two_full_phases_plus_discovery':measure(scoped+selected+full+full,2+2*n),
 'compliant_selective_global_two_full_phases_plus_discovery':measure(global_index+selected+full+full,2+2*n),
 'exploration_byte_reduction_scoped_pct':100*(1-(len(scoped)+len(selected))/len(full)),
 'compliant_byte_increase_scoped_pct':100*(len(scoped)+len(selected))/(2*len(full)),
 'generation_source_io_excluded_from_context_totals':{'reads':len(fs),'utf8_bytes':sum(len(v) for v in sources.values()),'allocation':'one global generation per matching canonical source set, shared across workloads; metadata parse performed by inventory generator'}})
r={'head':inv['head'],'tokenizer':{'available':False,'name':None,'version':None,'encoding':None,'reason':'No tiktoken/transformers/tokenizers in system Python or repo .venv; no model-tokenizer package found in bounded installed OpenSpec and pwa Node roots. CSS/YAML lexers are not model tokenizers. No install or estimate used.'},'protocol':'full phase = one source-file read per scoped canonical file; discovery = one index payload read + one selected payload read; baseline initial full + final full; compliant selective additionally index+selected. Shared governance/workload request and tool wrappers excluded equally. Generation source I/O is separately reported, never treated as free.','global_index':measure(global_index,1),'generation':{'canonical_file_reads':len(fs),'canonical_utf8_bytes':sum(len(v) for v in sources.values()),'inventory_metadata_file_reads':2,'elapsed_seconds_this_evidence_build':time.perf_counter()-start,'note':'Elapsed includes reading precomputed inventory, canonical hash validation and evidence serialization, not independent inventory parser generation.'},'workloads':results}
dump('results.json',r)
print(json.dumps({'global_index':r['global_index'],'generation':r['generation'],'workloads':[{k:v for k,v in w.items() if k in ('id','reference_requirement_count','reference_scenario_count','initial_recall','exploration_byte_reduction_scoped_pct','compliant_byte_increase_scoped_pct','full_phase','selected_phase','scoped_index','compliant_baseline_two_full_phases','compliant_selective_scoped_two_full_phases_plus_discovery')} for w in results]},indent=2))

"C0002":["intentional_overlap","Shared PDF transport limits apply separately to browser share staging and ordinary picker validation. Share commits staging and redirects; picker opens confirmation. Neither parses document content or certifies extraction."],
"C0003":["intentional_difference","Active workflow listing selects Processing/Paused across workflows; import summary counts Completed/Pending/Processing/Failed recipe-import instances and explicitly excludes Paused. Different endpoints, selections and response shapes; status terms do not imply contradiction."],
"C0004":["intentional_dependency","Demo restoration supplies default or configured cron; background-processing owns parsing and strictly future UTC-minute selection. At-target scenario agrees with the generic next-minute rule."],
"C0005":["intentional_overlap","Cooking single-page instruction editor and detail-field editor each retain their own draft after rejected save. Different UI contexts and pending controls; shared retry pattern is not duplicate ownership."],
"C0006":["intentional_difference","Ordinary backup/restore/disaster-recovery acceptance and demo snapshot capture invoke different workflows/endpoints. Demo capture explicitly has a mode guard; ordinary 202 envelope similarity establishes shared background acceptance convention only."],
"C0009":["intentional_overlap","Separate startup seeders guard separate workflow IDs: demo-restore versus dreaming. Both avoid duplicate Pending/Processing seeds, but demo has enabled-mode predicate and different cron. Paused history scenario is consistent with both guards."],
"C0010":["intentional_dependency","Shopping owns projected unchecked current-week extras in future-week views and edit targets; live-updates owns receiving eligible absolute-week collections. Same inclusion policy is intentionally reflected in read presentation and received reconciliation."],
"C0012":["intentional_dependency","Household access signature gate runs first; member gate only applies to pages subject to both gates. Onboarding can pass access without preselected member, so valid-access onboarding scenario does not contradict absent-member redirect for both-gated app pages."],
"C0013":["intentional_overlap","Member invite and voting nudge dialogs separately expose Copy/Share/dismiss patterns. Generated URLs and link-generation fallback differ; voting dialog additionally prohibits plan changes. UI consistency does not establish redundant capability behavior."],
"C0015":["intentional_overlap","Invite supplies accepted existing member ID after access writes; onboarding selection chooses a listed existing member. Both select identity and request Home under different triggers; no creation is required by either."],
"C0016":["intentional_dependency","Invite writes/selects supplied member and requests navigation; page gate later checks access then presence of member cookie. Post-invite gate failures remain possible and explicitly delegated."],
"C0018":["intentional_difference","Accepted invite supplying member ID changes selected identity/onboarding; Continue-as on Profile explicitly requests only Home with existing identity and no cookie write. Different triggers justify different side effects."],
"C0019":["intentional_dependency","Invite handling requests Home after supplied-member setup; hydrated root landing chooses Home/onboarding from current selected context. Navigation request is distinct from later identity validation, as both qualifications state."],
"C0020":["intentional_dependency","Memberless invite retains context and requests Home; later page member gate may redirect to onboarding if cookie absent. Explicit subject-to-existing-gate qualification resolves apparent Home versus onboarding difference."],
"C0022":["intentional_difference","Member creation pending disables name input; purge pending leaves PIN editing and Cancel available. Different form/action contexts; only common disabled-submit/progress vocabulary generated this candidate."],
"C0023":["intentional_overlap","Onboarding handoff follows creation of a new member; Profile selection chooses an already loaded member and creates none. Common selection/onboarding/Home steps serve distinct triggers."],
"C0024":["intentional_difference","New-member creation handoff writes/selects identity; Profile Continue-as explicitly preserves selected identity without writes or onboarding changes. Different actions, not competing rules for one action."],
"C0025":["intentional_difference","Assign accepts chosen recipe and relative target; move accepts dated-source indices and optional cross-week intent. Shared household API authentication is a dependency, while request identities and mutations differ."],
"C0026":["intentional_difference","Assign chooses target recipe/date; defer identifies exact sourceDate/recipe pair and rejects absent/AwaitingConsensus sources. Different operations and guards; common access rule is intentionally reused."],
"C0028":["intentional_difference","Empty-date recipe assignment creates Planned recipe-backed entry; non-cooking save creates recipe-free Skipped entry and may update existing non-cooking metadata. Default slot zero is a common representation invariant, not contradictory statuses for same trigger."],
"C0033":["intentional_difference","Move mutates calendar entries; voting open changes weekly plan/round while preserving entries. Both consume calendar-relative dates and household access, but triggers and effects are separate."],
"C0034":["intentional_difference","Move mutates source/destination content; direct lock changes weekly plan status and creates no suggested assignments. Shared date/access handling is intentional dependency."],
"C0035":["intentional_difference","Swap exchanges existing stored calendar content; non-cooking save creates/edits a recipe-free entry. Weekly status stays distinct/unchanged in each, while entry movement and entry persistence are separate triggers."],
"C0036":["intentional_difference","Defer recomputes affected groceries then publishes with request exclusion; overdue finalization publishes affected weeks without grocery recomputation or exclusion. Different mutation paths and explicit follow-up predicates avoid contradiction."],
"C0040":["intentional_overlap","URL intake advisory matches source URL; sharing bundle advisory matches recorded recipe ID/name. Both warn nonblocking and offer existing detail, but source identity predicates and entry flows differ."],
"C0042":["intentional_difference","Discovery queue ranks by current likes then recency; Browse ranks eligible promotions by affinity/date and ordinary rediscovery by recency/history/creation/identity. Different surfaces deliberately use different ranking priorities."],
"C0044":["intentional_dependency","Recipe-editing owns PATCH replacement/preservation of instruction metadata; recipe-library owns GET projection/null handling. Same stored member joins write and read obligations, with distinct triggers and no inline editor promise."],
"C0045":["intentional_dependency","Library navigation/list selection and quality reporting on already-loaded detail are different actions. Reporting explicitly consumes library loading/access context rather than redefining library navigation."],
"C0046":["intentional_dependency","Library fetches detail by selected recipe ID; quality offers reporting only after detail succeeds in viewing mode. Fetching and action availability are successive obligations, not same trigger/outcome."],
"C0047":["intentional_dependency","GET recipe detail and DELETE import-report target the same loaded recipe identity but perform distinct read/resolution operations. Resolution imposes its own member-existence guard; detail access transport is a shared dependency."],
"C0048":["intentional_difference","Library summary counts ready undeleted recipes; GOTO GET/PUT reads/replaces stored household list. Shared protected API vocabulary generated candidate, but resources, predicates and outcomes differ."],
"C0049":["intentional_difference","View Original navigates eligible source content; Move to Bin immediately soft-deletes from gear menu. Both require viewing mode but act on different resources with different eligibility and outcomes."],
"C0050":["intentional_difference","View Original requires URL provenance or original image count; Share requires ready recipe with nonplaceholder hero. Both hide during editing, but different action eligibility and behavior are explicitly scenario-covered."]
